kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Kalista's spears linger in their target for 4 seconds, stacking any number of times.

Active: Kalista rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing [5 / 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 + (0.7) × AD + (0.65) × AP] plus [7 / 14 / 21 / 28 / 35 + (0.2 / 0.275 / 0.35 / 0.425 / 0.5) × AD + (0.5) × AP] physical damage per spear beyond the first. Slows enemies hit by [0.1 / 0.18 / 0.26 / 0.34 / 0.42 + (0.0005) × AP] for [2] seconds.

If this Ability kills at least one target, its Cooldown is refreshed and it refunds [10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30] Mana.
